attention_semantics.causality: every key j <= i is visible; the current key is appended before the softmax that reads it

multi_token_prediction.reason: out of scope for this component

rope.note: which pairing a given GGUF conversion produced is a property of the checkpoint. It is carried in the configuration and exercised both ways by test, never assumed silently. Validating it against the real checkpoint belongs to the first approved multi-token run.
rope.pairing: NeoxHalfSplit is the declared default (ggml NEOX pairs i with i + n/2); Interleaved is the declared alternative

attention_semantics.score: (W_kb[h] q_nope) . c_j + rope(q_rope, i) . k_rope_j, scaled by attention_softmax_scale

softmax_scale_source.cross_check: the checkpoint's attention.key_length_mla (256) equals qk_nope + qk_rope and is asserted at startup
softmax_scale_source.mscale: 1: the checkpoint declares no rope scaling keys, so freq_scale is 1 and the YaRN log term vanishes

sparse_indexer.enforcement: max_positions may not exceed indexer_top_k; the runtime refuses longer sequences rather than substituting dense attention beyond the bound
sparse_indexer.inertness_argument: the indexer selects at most top_k causal keys; while the whole sequence is no longer than top_k every causal key is selected, so dense causal attention over the prefix is the same computation
sparse_indexer.present_in_the_checkpoint: blk.N.indexer.attn_k, indexer.attn_q_b, indexer.k_norm.{weight,bias}, indexer.proj (79 layers each)

attention_semantics.value_path: the attention-weighted latent is aggregated first and W_vb[h] is applied once to the aggregate

development_and_held_out.development: temporal fixture seeds 17030-17035 and the tiny in-test models
development_and_held_out.held_out: real-checkpoint prompts, which are selected and locked before any approved run and are not in this repository
development_and_held_out.run_ladder: 2, 4 then 8 positions, then short text prompts; derived from measured native timing, not assumed

entrypoint.python_role: independent reference and test harness only (scripts/research); never on the generation path

generation.cancellation: checked between positions; a cancelled run reports what it produced
generation.decode_rate_rule: no decode rate is reported for fewer than two generated tokens; one cold token's reciprocal is not a sustained rate
generation.mode: greedy only; there is no sampling option
generation.raw_token_mode: a labelled diagnostic (RAW_TOKEN_DIAGNOSTIC); it does not satisfy the text-CLI milestone on its own
generation.stop: the tokenizer's end-of-generation set; a terminal token is counted in generated_token_count and is never written to the answer stream
generation.streams: the answer on stdout, one diagnostics JSON object on stderr

measured_timing_basis.note: one cold position on the real checkpoint. It bounds admission budgets; it is not a throughput claim and no sustained rate has been measured.

model_identity.identity_check_weakening: PROHIBITED: there is no flag that skips the rehash, and no path or mtime is accepted as proof
model_identity.precision: f32 production buffers; the independent reference is binary64
model_identity.verification_frequency: once per session, before any generation; never once per token
verified_at_startup: directory is canonical and not a symlink
block_count, embedding_length, vocab_size, attention.head_count, attention.q_lora_rank, attention.kv_lora_rank, attention.key_length_mla, attention.value_length_mla, rope.dimension_count
tokenizer vocabulary size equals the model's

not_claimed: the rope pairing of the real checkpoint
indexer behaviour beyond its top-k budget

logits_and_attention_weights.source: frozen graph-differential thresholds from the checkpoint-free reconciliation, reused unchanged for the temporal extension

numeric_acceptance.position_zero: the temporal path must reproduce execute_one_token bit for bit at position 0 on the same source
numeric_acceptance.tolerance_rule: no threshold may be chosen from, or relaxed after, a deciding output

files_touched_in_the_bound_manifest.crates/f017-native/Cargo.toml: the tokenizer dependency and the new binaries
files_touched_in_the_bound_manifest.crates/f017-native/src/lib.rs: one `pub mod` declaration per new module; no behaviour of any bound entrypoint changes

predecessor.note: attempt 2 executed under authorization 2 and produced 154820 == expected; retry is not permitted and the authorization can never be reused. Its code_manifest describes readiness head 1fa68a556734c29450f23e88499e19bdc50df75d and is historical from that point on.

relationship_to_the_bounded_p1_contract.rule: this successor adds a separate surface; it does not widen, reinterpret or re-open the one-shot contract, and it cannot mint authority of any kind

state.append_order: strictly increasing position, every layer before the position is committed
state.bytes_per_position: layer_count * (kv_rank + qk_rope) * 4 = 79 * 576 * 4 = 182,016 bytes; 2048 positions is 372,768,768 bytes
state.failure: a step that fails rolls the state back to the last committed position, so a partially written position is never visible
state.ownership: the caller owns the state; weights are owned by the checkpoint session and are never part of state_bytes
state.prompt_to_decode_transition: none: prefill and decode execute the identical per-position path; only the token source differs
state.representation: per layer, per position: the RMS-normalised latent (kv_rank f32) and the rope key rotated at its own position (qk_rope f32)
state.reset: SequenceState::reset releases every retained position; state_bytes returns to 0
